title: v3 data foundation: play-by-play coverage
source: ESPN summary API `plays` (site.api.espn.com), stored by scripts/pbp_store.py; zero Odds API credits
complete_definition: every team-period lineup resolved cleanly (exactly five; every substitution consistent) AND >= 90% of the players who played have stint minutes within 1.5 min of their box minutes AND each team's stint minutes within 3.0 min of 5 x game length

failure_reasons.reason: incomplete: a team-period lineup did not resolve cleanly [games]
period start over-resolved (6 players by evidence; earliest five kept) [team-periods]
sub in of a player already on the floor [substitutions]
sub out of a player not on the floor [substitutions]
incomplete: < 90% of players within 1.5 min of box minutes [games]
incomplete: team stint minutes off by > 3 from 5 x game length [games]
period start over-resolved (7 players by evidence; earliest five kept) [team-periods]
period start over-resolved (8 players by evidence; earliest five kept) [team-periods]
period start over-resolved (9 players by evidence; earliest five kept) [team-periods]
period start over-resolved (10 players by evidence; earliest five kept) [team-periods]

notes: Period-1 fives are the box-score starters; later periods resolve from who acts or is subbed out before being subbed in, filled from the previous period's closing five.
Score-margin buckets: close = |margin| <= 10, mid = 10-15, garbage = > 15 in the 4th quarter or overtime; minutes accrue per play interval at the margin before the play.
Lineup possessions = FGA - OREB + TOV + 0.44 FTA from plays while the unit is on; units under 25 minutes are flagged thin.
actions_off_court counts plays whose participant was not on the tracked floor (free-throw / substitution ordering in the feed, or a lineup error); reported, not used.

game_context.note: vegas_total comes from the ESPN summary's pickcenter block, which ESPN keeps only for recent games: present for 979 of 3693 games here (none before 2025-26). Older seasons stay null without credits; the live slate run can fill it from the pre-game summary going forward. Context only, never a prop price.

local.verdict: unusable: no tracking or role endpoint answered; families (c), (d), (e) have no capture path from this environment
